summary: The prepared base reproducibly ignored selected Qwen4Exp capture flags and returned only the HC-wide stream. The exact candidate fixes capture ordering, applies the selected layer's learned HC contraction, preserves the ordinary and idle return contracts, and prevents the outer wrapper from overwriting auxiliary tensors. Focused regressions, independent routing checks, and an independent numerical check of the real GatedResidual implementation passed. Full target/drafter serving and acceptance remain unverified without checkpoints.

Candidate regression: selected learned contractions and ordering, unchanged ordinary/idle behavior, and wrapper non-overwrite behavior; 3 passed.
Candidate plus precedent/config regressions; 11 passed and 4 subtests passed.

Actual GPU GatedResidual.mix output shape (3,8), max absolute difference 2.9802322387695312e-08 versus independently expanded RMSNorm/gate/reduction formula, and 1.8565452098846436 versus incorrect uniform averaging.
